Name: Backpack Wardrobe
Author: POCHIMODS
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54342/54342-1792695457-1278863518.png[/img][/center]

[b]English[/b]
Press [b]F7[/b] to choose one purchased backpack or No backpack. Install SMAPI, then extract this download into Mods. [b]Backpacks are separate downloads[/b]—install only the designs you want. GMCM is optional.
[line]
[b]Español[/b]
Pulsa [b]F7[/b] para elegir una mochila comprada o Sin mochila. Instala SMAPI y extrae esta descarga en Mods. [b]Las mochilas se descargan aparte[/b]: instala solo las que quieras. GMCM es opcional.
[line]
[b]简体中文[/b]
按 [b]F7[/b] 选择一个已购买的背包或隐藏背包。避免 Hello Kitty 与 Cinnamoroll 重叠，保留物品和物品栏容量。安装 SMAPI，将此下载解压到 Mods。[b]背包外观需单独下载[/b]，只需安装喜欢的款式。GMCM 为可选。
[line]
[b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54337]Hello Kitty Backpack[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53977]Cinnamoroll Backpack[/url]

Downloads.DisplayName: Backpack Wardrobe - Menu only (EN ES ZH)
Downloads.Description: Shared F7 backpack menu. EN, ES and Simplified Chinese included. Requires SMAPI. GMCM optional. Hello Kitty and Cinnamoroll are separate downloads. Preserves purchases and inventory; only one backpack is drawn.

Manifest.Name: Backpack Wardrobe
Manifest.Description: Choose one purchased backpack from independent content packs with a shared wardrobe menu.
